Roll — Privacy Policy

Last updated: 17 August 2026

Roll is a food and body-composition tracker. This policy explains exactly what it collects, why, where it goes, and how to get rid of it. It matches the machine-readable declarations in the app's privacy manifest.

Who we are

Roll is operated by the app's developer, contactable at the support address on the App Store listing. That address is also the contact for any request in this policy.

What Roll collects

Account data. Your email address and, if you enter one, your name. This is your identity in the app — it is what lets your data follow you to a new phone.

What you log. Meals and their ingredients, portions, calories and macros; body weight; body measurements; and, if you enter them, blood biomarkers.

Health and fitness data. With your permission, Roll reads steps, active energy, workouts, body mass and body fat percentage from Apple Health, and can write the meals you log back to Apple Health. You can refuse or revoke this at any time in iOS Settings → Privacy & Security → Health; Roll keeps working without it, using estimates instead of measurements.

Photos you choose to analyse. A photo of a meal is sent for analysis and is not stored by us after the analysis returns.

Subscription status. Whether you have an active subscription, via RevenueCat and the App Store. Roll never sees your payment details — Apple handles the transaction and we only learn whether it succeeded.

Diagnostic and usage events. Records of how the app behaves and how it is used: that a meal was logged and by which method, that an analysis succeeded or failed and how long it took, that a target was recalculated, which screens were opened, which buttons were pressed, how far a screen was scrolled, and errors.

Events from one run of the app share a session identifier so we can see what happened before a fault. That identifier is regenerated every launch and is never stored on your device — it links events to each other, not to you across time.

These never contain food names, photos, weights, macros or any free text you typed. Screen and button names are internal identifiers, not what you see on screen. Diagnostics exist to tell us the app works, and you can switch them off entirely in Profile → Settings → Diagnostics — off means nothing is recorded, not recorded and withheld.

What Roll does NOT do

  • No advertising, no ad networks, no tracking SDKs. Nothing you do in Roll

is linked to data from other companies for advertising or measurement.

  • We never use Apple Health data for advertising or marketing. Apple's rules

forbid it and so do we.

  • We do not sell your data. Not to anyone, for any purpose, ever.
  • We do not use your logged data to train AI models.

Where your data goes

Supabase hosts the database and authentication. Your rows are protected by row-level security, meaning a signed-in user can read and write only their own data.

The meal-analysis provider receives the text description or photo you submit in order to estimate ingredients and macros. It receives the meal content only — not your name, email, weight, or health history.

RevenueCat and Apple handle subscriptions and receive only what is needed to validate a purchase.

Apple Health exchanges data directly on your device.

Legal basis and your rights

Where the UK/EU GDPR applies, we process account and logged data to perform our contract with you (providing the app), health data on the basis of your explicit consent (the Health permission prompt), and diagnostics on the basis of legitimate interest in a working product — which you can object to by turning diagnostics off.

You have the right to access, correct, export or delete your data, and to withdraw consent at any time.

Deleting your account deletes your data. Profile → Settings → Account & data → Delete account removes your account and the data associated with it. This is irreversible, so export first if you want a copy. Revoking Health permission stops further reads immediately; meals already written to Apple Health are yours and are removed through the Health app.

Retention

Logged data is kept until you delete it or delete your account. Diagnostic events are kept for 90 days and then removed automatically.

Children

Roll is not directed at children under 13 (under 16 in some regions) and we do not knowingly collect their data. A calorie-tracking app is also not appropriate for them without medical supervision.

Not medical advice

Roll estimates energy and macronutrient needs from formulas and from your own logged data. It is a guide, not a clinical instrument, and it is not medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Talk to a qualified professional before making significant changes to your diet, especially if you are pregnant, have an eating disorder, diabetes, kidney or heart conditions, or are cutting weight for sport.

Changes

If this policy changes materially we will say so in the app before the change takes effect.

Roll — the same document the app bundles, so the two cannot drift apart.
